answer: Give every identity a terrace of rising privileges: a newcomer starts on the lowest terrace, able to earn only tiny rewards, and climbs one terrace per epoch of verified honest work. Joining requires staking a small ember deposit that burns if the identity is caught copying or colluding. An attacker at the nadir of reputation cannot shortcut the climb: a thousand fakes must each pay the deposit, wait out the same epochs, and produce distinct graded work, so faking a crowd costs far more than earning honestly.
